model.architecture: Dense decoder-only transformer (GraniteForCausalLM, 40L, hidden 2560, GQA 40:8, untied embeddings); reasoning model that works problems inside <think>...</think>, thought channel declared in bundle metadata and the think opener pre-filled by the bundle's assistant prefix

session_defaults.notes: Reasoning model: give it a generous output budget (>=2048) - truncated mid-thought it produces no final answer. The declared thought channel routes reasoning out of the streamed answer and makes a thinking budget effective.

variants.quantization: int4 blockwise-32 + OCTAV linears, int8 embedding

recommended.reason: smaller AND faster than int8 on Metal (85.5 vs 70.7 tok/s decode); the phone build by size
full OpenCL delegation on Adreno (1783/1783, zero rejected ops), 1.7x the int8 decode, TTFT under 1 s; peak process RSS 1.4 GB

verified by generation on iPhone 17 Pro: Metal engine creates at the bundle's full 4096-token budget (init 13.0 s), composite 8Q gate 7/8 GPU / 8/8 CPU with the one GPU miss a composite-format artifact (the same question is answered correctly standalone on every platform); available memory never dropped below ~4.2 GB

platform_notes: Six prefill signatures (1024,256,64,16,4,1), 4096-token KV budget; the 6-signature ladder is deliberate - each exported signature is charged engine memory, and an 11-signature build of the same-shape granite-4.1-3b was killed by iOS at Metal engine init
